race.description: Gordon Pub Punters, A Gpg Hotel Hcp (Bm58)
race.comment: PRINCE OF VERONA (8) is the horse with the most upside after winning on debut at Bathurst, where he tracked the lead and picked up sharply on soft ground. He has already shown he handles rain-affected going and he deserves to be treated as the one to beat with the anticipated improvement. BIG OPINION (2) brings the deeper exposed profile, having been close up in a CL3 at Wagga. His effort prior on a heavy deck at Gundagai rates well also and he can put his best foot forward. CIAO BELLA MIA (5) has had excuses her past couple and her prior form stacks up in this field. Wet deck is no issue and she can play a leading role if luck swings her way. CLOUD OF DUST (11) was solid on resumption and drops in weight for this assignment. Maps nicely and can feature in the finish. BATTLE WARRIOR (10) is next best.
